# Synthflow adds comparisons between chosen agent versions


By OpenTools Team


Drafts can join the comparison; published‑version metadata still identifies what is live.


##


Choose the pair


With its[October 30 update](https://docs.synthflow.ai/changelog) , Synthflow lets maintainers compare any two agent versions, including a draft. Previously, comparisons were limited to the immediately preceding version. In version history, select Compare changes and choose the two revisions.


##


Check the live baseline


That lets a maintainer inspect a draft against the intended baseline rather than an intervening edit. The[October 23 entry](https://docs.synthflow.ai/changelog) describes a separate API inventory: published versions, newest first, with publisher, time and live status. Draft‑capable comparison and published‑version inventory answer different questions.


Engineers pair programming, December 2012; archival context, not Synthflow staff or interface.
